modules.killers: The two board-killers — empty editor, stripped CDP flags
modules.recovery: Recovery from stalls, faults and unhydrated editors
modules.stalls: How NOT to trigger stalls, hangs and refusals
modules.measurement: Measurement discipline — what counts as evidence

questions.q: An EasyEDA read returns ok=true with an empty array and no error. Name the ONE command you must never run in that state, because it saves before it closes and would write the empty document over the board. Command only.
A live read returns 0 components. Is that (a) an empty board, or (b) an ABORT? Single letter.
You must restart EasyEDA because its in-memory document is known bad. Complete: 'a graceful quit can ___ ; SIGKILL cannot ___'. Give the same three-word verb phrase for both blanks, once.
Which command-line flag does a plain `open -a EasyEDA-Pro` strip, disabling every CDP driver while the CLI keeps answering normally? Flag including its value.
Name the ONE probe that discriminates a hydrated editor from an unhydrated one — `doc ls`, `document.current`, `doc open` and `--force-stale-read` all fail to. Gateway verb.
Give the recovery order for an unhydrated editor as SIX comma-separated tokens, in order, drawn from: doc-open, kill, project-open, download, verify, reconnect
The GUI is dead or frozen. Give the tool you must run to relaunch EasyEDA correctly and the flag you must NOT pass, as '<file> without <flag>'.
After a reconnect the first heal often reports a specific error. Name it, and say whether you kill the new app or wait and retry. Answer as '<error> / <action>'.
Which log file names the CDP fix every 30 seconds and should be read FIRST when anything CDP-shaped misbehaves? Filename only.
`easyeda-run download` printed `null`, exited 0, and wrote no file. What does that prove about the session? Short cause, three words.
`project open --uuid <doc>` fails with EDA_CALL_FAILED while the app sits on its start page. What must be loaded first? One word.
Name the operation that paints a progress overlay stuck at 50/67/75 percent, never advances, and is now mechanically REFUSED. easyeda-run subcommand.
Give the exit code and reason string of that mechanical refusal, as '<code> <reason>'.
Which construct is permanently banned inside a command run over the host/device bridge, because it blocks the connection and presents as a stall? One word.
Two EasyEDA windows are open on one project. Complete the reason this is a hard stop: 'that is ___ ___ writers'. Three words total.
Name the two mutation mechanisms permanently banned in REV2 regardless of authorisation. Two comma-separated tokens.
What is the ONLY permitted actuation path onto EasyEDA in REV2? Executable name.
The gateway cannot do the thing you need. What do you do? Three words.
What is the current value of `certified_mutating_verbs`? One word.
Which script must run before the first read of a session, before every mutation batch, and after every application restart? Filename.
Preflight exit code meaning the editor holds no board. Number only.
Preflight exit code meaning the DRC call did not answer — which is NOT a clean board. Number only.
`pcb.drc.check` reports a top-level count. What is it a count OF, and what must you quote instead? Answer as '<what it counts> / quote the <what>'.
A status document says 280 DRC errors. A fresh readback says 362. Which wins? One word.
A checker documents a check its code does not implement. Complete: 'its PASS is worse than no gate, because it converts an unchecked action into an ___ one'. One word.
Blank or missing PAD_NET bodies do not prove disconnection. Name the surface that must never be used to infer connectivity. Two words.
EasyEDA's DSN export marks every wire and via with one attribute that makes Freerouting refuse to rip up or shove them. Exactly as it appears in the file.
Freerouting's -mt flag sizes which thread pool? One word. Autorouting itself is single-threaded, so more cores cannot help.
What is the control that lets Freerouting move copper on authorised nets only, leaving everything else fixed? Two words.
Pour `order` is assigned at creation and LOWER wins. The flood pour must therefore be created when? One word.
Name the project that is READ-ONLY and must never be opened, imported into, saved, or used as a live target while working REV2.
The active document does not match expected project identity. Posture: 'best effort' or 'stop / blocked'? Answer with one of those two.
No `easyeda/K1-CORE-VAL-REV2.epro2` exists. Which gate are you at? Gate id.
